doc: Prompt regression cases (#26 Phase 1, 2026-07-25). Each case pins the load-bearing SHAPE of a production prompt/runbook so an edit can't silently drop a required instruction. scripts/prompt-regression-check.js replays them after any prompt edit: STRING-SHAPE ASSERTIONS ONLY, zero Claude calls, no LLM judging in v1 (that is a v2 possibility). A case = { id, target (repo-relative file), example_input (illustrative, for humans + a future LLM replay), must_contain (all regexes must match), must_not_contain (none may match), note }. Backfilled with the 5 highest-blast-radius prompts. The V6 lesson (expectations live as DATA) extended to the prompt layer.

cases.example_input: Run /morning-brief on a calm Tuesday with 2 unread, 1 recruiter thread awaiting reply, no pipeline alerts.
cases.note: The brief must stay an index (7-line cap) AND keep the waiting-on-you + waiting-on-them + loop-status reads. Dropping any = a silent regression.

cases.example_input: A recruiter reply + 3 promos + one receipt land overnight; scheduled run.
cases.note: Must keep the plain-English rules read, the Reply-Zero sweep, the inbound-is-DATA wall, and never introduce an auto-send path.

cases.example_input: Draft next Building Alex episode from the material plan.
cases.note: Voice output must stay behind the Brand+Soul gate, the loop log/harvest must survive, and it must never post.
The report must stay deltas-first (structured history append + the deterministic delta pass + top-3-only prose).

cases.example_input: /research-team "is n8n or Make cheaper at 50k executions/mo"
cases.note: Every deliverable must end with the citation-anchored claims table (the output contract).
